lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I had so much fun today, Honey.
Huh?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I had no idea you were so aggressive.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe!
What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: After you had your way with me,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: how can you pretend not to have a clue?
I'm gonna need an explanation.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Good grief, you're so dense.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Just play along.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Let's try this again.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You need to act like we're two star-crossed lovers who just came back from a whirlwind rendezvous.
Why are you so obsessed with role-play all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I need proof that you and I are on good terms,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: so I want to have a record of us having a good time.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Preferably in written form.
I won't do it.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Personally, I thought it was a good idea.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So you don't want a record of our affection?
Not if it's all an act.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ah, I get it now!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Fine then, it's not fake whatsoever.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Is this you promising to take me on a proper date?
How did you come to that conclusion?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: If we really do go on a date, then it won't be fake.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: A hot date that we don't have to worry about recording for posterity.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Looking forward to seeing unleash your animalistic side!
